name: ThullaCounter
description: Browser-only Bhabhi Thulla & chess scoreboard for university breaks. One-tap losses, 51 real meme sounds, Hall of Shame, WhatsApp challans. No backend.

paragraphs: ThullaBoard is a browser-only scoreboard for the two games that ruin friendships during university breaks: Bhabhi Thulla (the card game where everyone escapes except one) and Chess. It keeps an indisputable record of who lost how many times, crowns the Chief Bhabhi, fires a wall of slaps and desi memes on every loss, and generates a WhatsApp challan you can paste straight into the group chat.
No backend, no accounts, no database. Everything lives in localStorage on the phone that keeps score.
features: Roster management — add, rename inline, remove, and toggle who is at the table without deleting anyone.
One-tap Bhabhi tracking — a big tap target per player; the loss count, live losing streak, and round counter update instantly.
Chess 1v1 tracker — white/black pickers, win/win/draw outcomes, per-pair head-to-head records with a win-share bar.
Hall of Shame — ranked by losses, crown on the current Chief Bhabhi, Clean Sheet badge for the untouched, Today / All-time switch.
The storm — every Bhabhi tap fires all 8 slaps, all 6 voice clips, and 3 desi memes in one scheduling pass on the audio clock, behind a soft-clip limiter so 17 overlapping sources never distort.
